This is the smoking gun. The released provider at `eval-release` returns **only `{"ok": True}`** — it has no `applied` key and ignores `require_receipt`. The new client unconditionally raises when `applied is not True`, so every ordinary save against the supported baseline provider will now fail.

Let me materialize the evidence bundle (Bash file-writes are denied in this mode, so I'll use the Write tool) and then spawn the independent reviewer.
